stack.env: tools/final_env.sh + R69 accepted flags (NANOV41_MHC_V4=1 V4_MODE=split MOE_LAYOUT=fast ATTN_DKV_BF16=1 MOE_DWS_INLINE=1 MOE_TILE=64,64,64,4,3)
stack.shape: b=16 x seq=1024; graph-only (capture fwd+loss+bwd, optimizer outside); 2 warm steps + 20 timed replays
stack.optimizer: AdamW fused disabled (mixed bf16/fp32 param dtypes)

d12.engram_gate: Inductor/Triton fused bf16 gate (official TileLang kernels require hidden_size % 256 == 0; 384 unsupported natively)

d16.engram_gate: official DeepSeek TileKernels `tile_kernels.engram` TileLang gate fwd/bwd (MIT), native hidden 512, TILE_KERNELS_PATH=/root/TileKernels
d16.caveat: d16 CE head v3 falls back to the bf16 head (v3 only supports d=384), so absolute d16 step is not comparable to d12; the A/B relative overhead is.

notes: The historical R69 58 ms baseline was measured on a west-D host with torch 2.12.1; this bj-B1 host with the same final_env gives 66.3 ms median, so absolute step times are host/env dependent. The deliverable here is the same-process/round pair relative overhead.

TL padded-hidden path (for dims 384/640) exists in nanov41/engram_tl.py but is not enabled: forward rescaling is exact, but the backward chain-rule mapping for the padded RMSNorm needs more validation; dispatcher only uses TL when hidden_size % 256 == 0 (d16).
